create_bar_chart.description: Build a bar chart from your labels and one or more data series, and get back a URL to the chart image.
create_bar_chart.name: create_bar_chart

parameters.description: The category names along the bottom of the chart (or one per pie slice), separated by commas. For example: January, February, March.
parameters.name: labels

parameters.description: One or more data series to plot. Each series has a name and a comma-separated list of numbers, one number per label.
parameters.name: datasets

label.description: Name of this series, shown in the legend.

values.description: This series' numbers, in the same order as the labels, separated by commas. For example: 10, 20, 30.

parameters.description: Optional title shown above the chart.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Draw the bars horizontally instead of vertically.
parameters.name: horizontal

parameters.description: Background colour of the image, as a colour name or hex code. Defaults to white. Use 'transparent' for no background.
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.description: Image width in pixels. Defaults to 500.
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Image height in pixels. Defaults to 300.
parameters.name: height

url.description: Permanent URL that renders the chart image.

create_pie_chart.description: Build a pie chart from your labels and their values, and get back a URL to the chart image.
create_pie_chart.name: create_pie_chart

parameters.description: The category names along the bottom of the chart (or one per pie slice), separated by commas. For example: January, February, March.
parameters.name: labels

parameters.description: The number for each slice, in the same order as the labels, separated by commas. For example: 30, 45, 25.
parameters.name: values

parameters.description: Optional title shown above the chart.

parameters.description: Background colour of the image, as a colour name or hex code. Defaults to white. Use 'transparent' for no background.
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.description: Image width in pixels. Defaults to 500.
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Image height in pixels. Defaults to 300.

url.description: Permanent URL that renders the chart image.

description: Turn your data into bar, line, and pie chart images you can drop into emails, messages, and documents: no account required.
